name: Taysir
description: A figure who put Leshrac in an oubliette to use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah.

description_citations.text: "Walker of Night". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A well-dressed man murders an unarmed man in the forest of Fa'adiyah; the survivor mixes blood with the dead man and is overwhelmed by his memories, and Nailah calls him her Apprentice.
timeline.quote: She addresses him as her Apprentice and admonishes him for his weakness.

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nailah and the Apprentice use the Ring of Ma'Rûf to find the Nomad Taysir; the Apprentice rebels, gives the Ring to the Nomad and attacks Nailah.
timeline.quote: He thrusts the Ring into the Nomad's hands

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Nomad reaches the Bazaar of Bassorah and finds the Dervish with Raghib, who blames Nailah for his leprosy.
timeline.quote: Raghib recognizes the Ring and blames Nailah for inflicting leprosy upon him after he betrayed her.

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nailah imprisons the Apprentice in an oubliette and reveals she wants the united Taysir to make her queen of all Rabiahs.
timeline.quote: queen of all Rabiahs

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nailah tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish, but he refuses and attacks her; gravely wounded, he tells the Dervish to take his life and escape to find the last Taysir.
timeline.quote: Nailah appears and tempts the Nomad to slay the Dervish.

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dervish and Raghib reach the castle of El-Hajjâj, where Raghib exposes the water as an illusion.
timeline.quote: Raghib touches the water and recognizes it as an illusion

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dervish opens the city in a bottle and, urged by El-Hajjâj, sacrifices the Baby Taysir within.
timeline.quote: proceeds to sacrifice the child

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nailah kills El-Hajjâj and Raghib and wounds the Apprentice; the Dervish blasts her and merges with the Apprentice, becoming the complete Taysir.
timeline.quote: She kills El-Hajjâj and Raghib, and wounds the Apprentice

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir planeswalks away from Nailah, who bars him from returning to any plane of Rabiah.
timeline.quote: Nailah enacts her final revenge, barring Taysir from returning to any of the many planes of Rabiah.

citation.text: "Arabian Nights (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Thousandfold Refraction of Rabiah, Taysir is copied only five times, once for each color.
timeline.quote: he was copied only five times, once for each color of mana, instead of a thousand times

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Arabian Nights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nailah seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one.
timeline.quote: Nailah seduced the black version of Taysir and had him kill and absorb the green one

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Arabian Nights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The nomad Taysir defeats Nailah and merges with his last counterpart, becoming the most powerful wizard in the multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Nomad Taysir eventually came back for the others, defeated Nailah, and merged with his last living counterpart.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Arabian Nights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Taysir becomes a planeswalker, Nailah's seduction fails; he blasts her and leaves, and she bars him from returning.
timeline.quote: created a barrier around the Rabiahs, preventing him from ever returning.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Arabian Nights". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is killed but revived by Kristina and Taysir, and plots vengeance.
timeline.quote: Ravidel plotted vengeance for ages

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise, Kristina, Taysir and others cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard.
timeline.quote: ended both the Ice Age and the time of the Shard

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn hosts the Summit of the Null Moon with the planeswalkers trapped in the Shard.
timeline.quote: For ten centuries, they have been trapped within a tiny formation of twelve worlds

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina and Taysir resurrect Ravidel, who declares Kristina his enemy.
timeline.quote: He doesn't agree with Kristina changing his fate and declares her his enemy forever.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise unleashes the World Spell, breaking the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: Taysir and Kristina witness the breaking of the enchantments that caused the Ice Age.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leshrac is tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia, later freed.
timeline.quote: He was eventually tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir is trapped in the Shard on Dominaria and falls in love with Kristina of the Woods on Corondor.
timeline.quote: he met and fell in love with a fellow planeswalker Kristina of the Woods .

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir and Kristina help Freyalise cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard; the two part ways.
timeline.quote: This ended the Ice Age of Dominaria and ended the time of the Shard.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel duels Liana for her Moxes and reveals his master is Taysir.
timeline.quote: He reveals to her that his Master is Taysir

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir tells Daria that Serra and Feroz are long dead but their spirit survives.
timeline.quote: "Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."

citation.text: Serra Aviary (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Daria feels an aether storm is wrong.
timeline.quote: "I do love the rain . . . but this storm feels somehow wrong, Taysir."

citation.text: Aether Storm (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taysir calls the werewolves the Baron's lieutenants.
timeline.quote: "The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."

citation.text: Greater Werewolf (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacked the returning Sandruu and defeated him.
timeline.quote: Taysir defeated Sandruu but was then attacked by a friend of the exiled planeswalker, Feroz .

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir enslaved the Anaba and summoned an earthquake against Feroz, killing many Anaba and destroying the pictoglyph caves.
timeline.quote: Taysir enslaved the Anaba, and many of them were killed when Taysir summoned an earthquake against Feroz, which also destroyed the pictoglyph caves.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz killed Taysir; the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and revived him as an ally two centuries later.
timeline.quote: Feroz eventually killed Taysir, but the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and spent two centuries calming his soul, reviving him as a kind and humble ally.

citation.text: "Minotaur", section "Anaba Minotaurs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir defeats Leshrac but cannot kill him and imprisons him deep in Phyrexia instead.
timeline.quote: he imprisoned Leshrac deep in hellish Phyrexia instead

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Homelands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir attacks Sandruu, banishes him to a remote plane, and is killed by Feroz on Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: killed him by splitting his skull with a broadsword.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "First death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir follows Sandruu to Ulgrotha, defeats and exiles him, and is then defeated by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Their duel was won by Taysir, who exiles Sandruu to a remote plane.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir confesses his love and asks Kristina to marry him.
timeline.quote: He has fallen in love with her, his constant traveling companion

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina turns Taysir away and he turns to vengeance against Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: she has no choice but to turn him away

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Embereck dies fighting Ravidel and Leshrac flees; Taysir then confronts Ravidel, who nearly defeats his mentor until Teferi intervenes.
timeline.quote: Embereck perished in the battle, and Leshrac fled.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir reconciles with Sandruu, and Teferi and Eskil free Daria from the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Teferi retrieved Daria's Amber Prison, and with Eskil’s help, freed her at last.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir arrives in Corondor, seeks Kristina, and flees on learning she has another lover.
timeline.quote: Realizing that Kristina has taken yet another lover, Taysir flees, hurt and confused.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Embereck is destroyed and Leshrac flees; Taysir confronts Ravidel and is saved by Teferi.
timeline.quote: The weakened Embereck is destroyed, and Leshrac is forced to flee.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is horrified that Taysir disapproves of his war and sees it as betrayal.
timeline.quote: Initially ecstatic to see his mentor again, Ravidel is horrified when Taysir tells him he does not approve of the war orchestrated in his name.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian gremlins grab the Mox Beacon and haul it to Phyrexia to destroy it after Taysir opens a door to the Hell of Artifice.
timeline.quote: Numerous Phyrexian gremlin rush out and grab the Beacon, then haul it over to Phyrexia to destroy it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Force of Nature trap and the Chime's chaos make the earth collapse and swallow Ravidel.
timeline.quote: The earth around Ravidel collapses, and he falls.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir takes Ravidel on as a spellsquire.
timeline.quote: took him on as a spellsquire

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel and Taysir trap Leshrac in Phyrexia, but Szat stays out of reach.
timeline.quote: They found Leshrac and trapped him in Phyrexia

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tells Taysir that Kristina has taken a lover, provoking Taysir to attack Sandruu.
timeline.quote: Ravidel gleefully brought him the news that Kristina had taken a lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ulgrotha Sandruu is banished and Taysir is slain by Feroz.
timeline.quote: Taysir was slain by the guardian of the Homelands, Feroz

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza drains Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs and later destroys Taysir; the Titans mutiny.
timeline.quote: Urza used the same failsafe and destroyed Taysir.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza assembles planeswalkers with his Titan Engines but the gathering draws Phyrexians to Tolaria, so they go to Koilos.
timeline.quote: the gathering of ‘walkers draws the Phyrexians to the island, so they abandon it, traveling to Koilos to plan for the great battle.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza is convinced to kill Taysir, then is taken to see Mishra in the Seventh Sphere and brought to worship Yawgmoth in the Ninth.
timeline.quote: Next, he went to the Ninth Sphere to worship Yawgmoth himself, along with Gerrard.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Counter attack and betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over two centuries the Anaba Ancestors redeem Taysir's spirit and he returns in a withered body, taking Daria as apprentice.
timeline.quote: On Ulgrotha he found a young native planeswalker, Daria , and took her as his apprentice and as his foster daughter.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "The Planeswalkers War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir is recruited among the Nine Titans for the attack on Phyrexia, with Daria taking Teferi's place and Urza insisting on Szat.
timeline.quote: Taysir was one of the Nine Titans recruited by Urza to participate in the attack on Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Urza switches allegiance to Phyrexia, Taysir attacks him and Urza kills him by activating the kill rubric in his Titan Engine.
timeline.quote: Urza activated the kill rubric in Taysir's Titan Engine , killing him.

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Windgrace performs the ritual of Dalfir on Taysir's body.
timeline.quote: performed the ritual of Dalfir on him

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza defects to Phyrexia and kills Taysir.
timeline.quote: He defects, joins Phyrexia and kills Taysir .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Phyrexian Invasion (4205 AR to 4206 AR) [ 16 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Phyrexia Urza is grasped by its beauty and Yawgmoth gets him to destroy the master soul bomb; Urza activates his kill rubric when Taysir confronts him.
timeline.quote: getting Urza to join his side and destroy the master soul bomb

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bo Levar, Guff, Freyalise and Windgrace discover Urza's treachery and Taysir's death and decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.
timeline.quote: They decide to set off the Soul Bombs manually.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caliphear is unsummoned by Ravidel; Ravidel reveals his master is Taysir of Rabiah.
timeline.quote: his master was none other than Taysir of Rabiah

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir's arrival banishes Sandruu and destroys the Anaba minotaurs' mural history, prompting Feroz and Serra to act.
timeline.quote: Feroz and his wife Serra decided it was time to do something

citation.text: "Feroz's Ban", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza fell under Yawgmoth's influence, dismantled the master soul bomb, slew Taysir and submitted to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza then abandoned his cause and submitted himself to Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Gutting of Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir banishes Sandruu but Feroz kills him with a broadsword.
timeline.quote: Feroz kills him by splitting his skull with a broadsword

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Taysir duel, and the Anaba pictograph history is destroyed.
timeline.quote: It was also here that the duel between Feroz and Taysir took place

citation.text: "Kher Range", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina meets and falls in love with Taysir; they are trapped in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds after its formation

citation.text: "Kristina of the Woods", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina leaves Taysir; he banishes Sandruu, her new love.

citation.text: "Kristina of the Woods", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Nailah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Nailah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Nailah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Nailah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Nine Titans", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Later Freyalise insisted that Kristina would come along, apparently just to spite Taysir, and Urza agreed

citation.text: "Nine Titans", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir tells Leshrac he will use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah, having been refused by Kristina of the Woods.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Ravidel and Taysir drain him, Leshrac casts a spell that saves his life; the portal fails and he remains trapped as an incorporeal shade, his excess energy flowing into the people of Estark.
timeline.quote: His excess energy then flows into the people of Estark

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
